description.zh: 画布上常用的辅助工具：轴网和坐标系
description.en: Common helpers for the canvas: a structural grid and a coordinate system

grid.description: A structural grid over the current level's walls: numbered axes along x, lettered along y, every `spacing` mm from the origin (by default the walls' north-west corner). Its intersections snap furniture and walls when `snap` is on. Move the origin with originX/originY (mm), or drag its handle.

originX.description: x of the origin, mm; null for the walls' west edge

originY.description: y of the origin, mm; null for the walls' north edge

snap.description: Whether the intersections snap furniture and walls

axes.description: A coordinate system on the current level: an x axis pointing east and a y axis pointing south (as the plan's), from an origin (by default the walls' north-west corner), `length` mm long, with a tick every `tick` mm. The origin and the ticks snap furniture and walls when `snap` is on. Move the origin with originX/originY (mm), or drag its handle.

tick.description: Distance between ticks, mm; 0 for none

originX.description: x of the origin, mm; null for the walls' west edge

originY.description: y of the origin, mm; null for the walls' north edge

snap.description: Whether the origin and the ticks snap furniture and walls
